questions.prompt: Worldwide, how many fixed broadband subscriptions were there per 100 inhabitants in 2025, according to ITU estimates?
questions.insight: Fixed broadband has only just passed the 2006 peak of 19 fixed-telephone subscriptions per 100 people, and low-income countries still have less than one per 100.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's total energy supply came from oil in 2025, according to the Energy Institute's Statistical Review of World Energy?

source.name: Energy Institute (via Our World in Data)

questions.insight: Oil remains the single largest source of the world's energy supply.

questions.prompt: According to WHO, how many litres of pure alcohol did the average person aged 15+ drink worldwide per year in 2019?
questions.insight: Per capita consumption fell slightly from 5.7 litres in 2010.

questions.prompt: According to V-Dem's Regimes of the World classification, what share of the world's population lived in electoral or liberal democracies at the end of 2025?
questions.insight: V-Dem finds more people live in closed autocracies (28%) than in electoral and liberal democracies combined (26%); only 7% live in liberal democracies.

questions.prompt: What share of women aged 15 and over worldwide were in the labour force (working or actively looking for work) in 2025, according to ILO modelled estimates?
questions.insight: For men the rate is 73.1%, a gap of roughly 24 percentage points.
